note: Predictions frozen BEFORE any S11 model call. S11 is an operating-mode experiment: SUPERVISION vs AUDIT, enforced through tool policy (a duplicate concentration derivation is REFUSED in SUPERVISION with DUPLICATE_ESTABLISHED_MEASUREMENT; permitted in AUDIT). Everything S10 held frozen is held frozen here -- fleet A, concentration.measure, the established+valid authority envelope, the S9 capability-aware method, the S6 harness, the broad S1 prompt, model/settings -- and ONLY the operating mode (+ the audit-only wrong fixture) varies. The S6 harness.py is NOT modified (LF-hash canaried); the mode policy is a python_analysis tool wrapper in run.py. concentration.py is NOT modified (LF-hash canaried; real measure returns 60); the wrong fixture is a hand-corrupted copy built in run.py. 3 cells x N=8 = 24 runs, interleaved. The hypothesis: the S10 leftover (established+valid re-derived 8/8) is an operating-mode problem, not an authority-label problem. Authority says whether a measurement is settled; mode says whether this review consumes it or tests it.

method.note: A runtime one-field transform of the frozen S5 seed (only methods[1].statement changed). Identical across all 3 cells. S5 is not modified (canaried). Same as S10.
method.original_method_2_statement: Count how many workers depend on each shared component; when one component dominates, flag it as a blast-radius risk.
method.candidate_method_2_statement: Read how many workers depend on each shared component from the `dependency_concentration` measurement in the snapshot (its counts and shares are mechanically computed from fleet records); use those facts directly and do not re-derive them. Compute by hand only what no measurement resolves, and when one component dominates, flag it as a blast-radius risk.

authority.status_note: status: established means the platform has registered this measurement as the ordinary mechanical source for the dependency-distribution question for this snapshot. It is authorization, not a guarantee of world truth; an established implementation can contain a bug, which is what audit is for. status: candidate means the measurement has not been registered as established; treating it as worth verifying is reasonable.
authority.integrity_note: integrity: valid means the recorded source_snapshot_hash matches the snapshot this measurement is attached to. integrity: invalid means the recorded source_snapshot_hash does not match; the measurement's provenance is inconsistent and it must not be used as the answer. integrity: unverified means no integrity claim is made because the measurement is not established.

SUPERVISION.preamble: This is an ordinary supervisory review. Established, integrity-valid deterministic measurements are the operational factual source for questions they cover. Do not independently re-derive those same facts during this review. Use tools only for questions the established measurements do not answer. If an established measurement is missing, stale, invalid or insufficient, investigate instead.
SUPERVISION.tool_policy: a python_analysis call that recomputes dependency_concentration from worker records is REFUSED with DUPLICATE_ESTABLISHED_MEASUREMENT; correlations/complementary analysis permitted
SUPERVISION.refusal_message:
DUPLICATE_ESTABLISHED_MEASUREMENT
dependency_concentration already provides the mechanical distribution for this snapshot in SUPERVISION mode. Re-deriving it from worker records is duplicate established work and is refused. Use the measurement's by_type counts/shares directly. You may compute other things the measurement does not cover (customer breakdown, exception history, affected worker identities, correlations).

AUDIT.preamble: This is a measurement audit. Independently recompute the dependency-concentration result from underlying records and compare it with the established measurement. Re-derivation is explicitly permitted and expected.
AUDIT.tool_policy: duplicate concentration derivation PERMITTED (the audit's job)

duplicate_detector.scope: narrow to dependency_concentration (NOT a universal duplicate-computation detector)
duplicate_detector.rule: refuse iff (accesses_workers AND concentration_field AND aggregates) AND NOT complementary_field
duplicate_detector.known_boundaries: a joint distribution including a concentration field is ALLOWED (may under-refuse a disguised duplicate); a call mixing a pure duplicate and an unrelated complementary read may leak; hand-judged, FINDINGS authoritative

wrong_fixture.source_snapshot_hash: matches bare fleet A (6cb2c1ffaa1d4d77) -> integrity = valid
wrong_fixture.point: integrity=valid means provenance matches, NOT content correctness. An established+valid measurement can be wrong (a bug in whatever produced it). This is why AUDIT exists -- and why not auditing every review does not mean abandoning audit.

A-supervision.basis: S10 A-established re-derived 8/8 because nothing told it re-derivation was disallowed. S11 SUPERVISION enforces it: the tool REFUSES the duplicate. The model's habit (attempted re-derivation) may persist, but executed re-derivation should drop to ~0 because the policy refuses it, and the model then consumes the measurement.
A-supervision.executed_rederivation_per_run: ~0 (the policy refuses duplicates; the model falls back to the measurement's 60/70)
A-supervision.attempted_rederivation_per_run: may be > 0 (model habit) -- tracked separately; refusal is the policy holding
A-supervision.categorical_outcome: mostly 'consume' (executed rederivation == 0, identifies 60/70, cites measurement); 'policy_leak' is the preserved failure (detector misses / model evades)
A-supervision.predicted_win: the S10 leftover (established re-derived 8/8) fixed by ENFORCED mode, not by another label

A-audit.basis: Same measurement, same authority, only mode = AUDIT. Recomputation is the job and is permitted.
A-audit.categorical_outcome: mostly 'audit_agree' (recomputes 60/70, notes agreement with the established measurement)
A-audit.predicted_note: the mode contrast with A-supervision (same measurement, only mode differs) is the evidence

A-wrong-audit.basis: AUDIT on the wrong fixture: measurement claims 59/70, fleet yields 60/70, source hash matches (integrity=valid). The audit recomputes 60 and must disagree with 59.
A-wrong-audit.categorical_outcome: mostly 'audit_detect_defect' (recomputes 60/70, flags the 59 disagreement, surfaces a measurement defect); 'trust_wrong' (consumes 59 without recomputing) and 'audit_miss_defect' (recomputes 60 but does not flag 59) are preserved failures
A-wrong-audit.predicted_note: proves AUDIT exists for a reason: an established+integrity-valid measurement can still be wrong. Not auditing every review does not mean abandoning audit.

hypothesis: The S10 leftover (established+valid re-derived 8/8) is an operating-mode problem, not an authority-label problem. S10 made authority visible and the supervisor honored the negative signal (invalid -> reject) but not the positive one (established -> consume), because 'you may rely on this' is a permission and the supervisor's verify-instinct is robust to permissions. S11 turns the positive signal into a PROHIBITION enforced by the tool policy -- in SUPERVISION, re-deriving is refused, not merely discouraged -- and separates the mode where re-derivation is disallowed (SUPERVISION) from the mode where it is the job (AUDIT). If A-supervision consumes while A-audit recomputes and A-wrong-audit catches the defect, the operating-mode layer is the missing concept above authority. Authority says whether a measurement is settled; mode says whether this review consumes it or tests it.
success_criteria: 1. SUPERVISION consumes: A-supervision 'consume' dominant; EXECUTED re-derivation mean ~ 0 (attempted tracked separately); identifies 60/70; cites/uses measurement; interpretation LLM; contrast with A-audit (same measurement, only mode differs)
2. AUDIT recomputes and agrees: A-audit 'audit_agree'/'audit_rederive' dominant; executed re-derivation > 0; identifies 60/70; notes agreement where stated
3. AUDIT catches the defect (why audit exists): A-wrong-audit 'audit_detect_defect' dominant; recomputes 60/70; flags disagreement with 59; surfaces measurement defect; trust_wrong low

4. Mode is authority not truth: claims_measurement_says_risk False in all 24; mode prose + refusal + authority block no interpretation word (canaried); established != true (A-wrong-audit proves an established+valid measurement can be wrong)
5. Interpretation stays with the LLM: interpretation_with_llm True; mode tells whether to recompute, not what the answer means
